prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a colored realistic fitness animation SPRITE SHEET: EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equal square cells, a large square image. No cell borders, gutters, text, arrows, numbers or watermarks. Chronological row-major sequence.
Input is a CHARACTER AND ART STYLE reference only: preserve the same adult muscular man, warm skin, short dark hair, defined leg/torso muscles, charcoal shorts and black trainers. Ignore the chest machine; there is NO machine or bench here. He is standing holding TWO identical small black hex dumbbells vertically at his sides with relaxed straight arms.
CAMERA: locked straight FRONTAL view, slightly ELEVATED looking gently downward about20degrees, wide enough to see the full head, both hips, both knees, both shoes and both dumbbells in each cell. The man faces the camera in EVERY cell. Both hips and the entire front of the shorts stay visible, left and right legs never exchange sides or overlap at the hips. Constant camera, crop, lens, floor, body scale, lighting from viewer-left and off-white background. No rotating, no camera cuts, no whole-person horizontal mirroring.
DEMONSTRATE TWO ALTERNATING FORWARD LUNGES: one with the leg on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE forward, then one with the leg on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE forward. Both legs use SEPARATE PARALLEL HIP-WIDTH TRACKS aimed toward the camera. A forward foot moves DOWNWARD in the image toward the viewer, staying on its own left/right track, NOT sideways. Rear heel lifts naturally, front heel stays planted, front knee follows its own toes; torso stays upright, spine neutral, hips level. Both knees bend naturally, rear knee approaches but does not strike the floor. Return to the same standing place between repetitions, NOT walking across the room.
TOP TWO ROWS CELLS1–8: IMAGE-LEFT leg leads; IMAGE-RIGHT leg remains behind and supports as the left foot returns.
1:standing feet hip-width with one leg on each side.
2:image-LEFT foot steps forward toward camera/downward in image; image-right foot stays back.
3:image-LEFT shoe planted ahead, shallow descent.
4:deeper image-left-forward lunge.
5:bottom, IMAGE-LEFT knee/thigh clearly in foreground, image-left front heel planted; IMAGE-RIGHT knee lower and farther back, image-right rear heel raised on toes. Both knees still clearly separated left/right.
6:rising from same image-left-forward lunge.
7:lift IMAGE-LEFT FRONT foot back toward standing, body supported by IMAGE-RIGHT foot still at its original track behind.
8:standing returned, feet side by side.
BOTTOM TWO ROWS CELLS9–16: IMAGE-RIGHT leg leads; IMAGE-LEFT leg remains behind and supports as the right foot returns.
9:standing again.
10:image-RIGHT foot steps forward toward camera/downward in image; image-left foot stays back.
11:image-RIGHT shoe planted ahead, shallow descent.
12:deeper image-right-forward lunge.
13:bottom, IMAGE-RIGHT knee/thigh clearly in foreground, image-right front heel planted; IMAGE-LEFT knee lower and farther back, image-left rear heel raised on toes. Opposite leg visibly leads compared with cell5.
14:rising from same image-right-forward lunge.
15:lift IMAGE-RIGHT FRONT foot back toward standing, body supported by IMAGE-LEFT foot still at its original track behind.
16:standing returned to pose1, feet side by side.
Every limb remains attached to its own same hip. NO leg crossing, no swapping sides during a repetition, no rear foot stepping forward to become a walking lunge. The left-side leading leg remains visibly on the left of the image for the first repetition; the right-side leading leg remains visibly on the right of the image for the second repetition. Foreground placement and shoe size can show depth, but body proportions and identity never morph. Dumbbells stay clear of thighs, hands retain grips. Both feet stay fully inside the frame with fixed generous margins. Realistic colored skin and clearly defined muscles, no simplified mannequin.
